text: If your website sounds like AI wrote it, your customers can tell.
Here's why. You typed: write my homepage.
And it gave you this. Welcome to our website, where passion meets excellence.
That line fits every business on earth. So it sells nobody.
Fix one. Tell it who you help, and where.
Like: emergency plumber for families in Penrith.
Fix two. Paste in your real reviews, so it uses your customers' words.
Fix three. Ask what a nervous customer worries about, then answer it.
Now you get this. Burst pipe at midnight? Fixed today, with upfront prices.
Send this to someone who needs it, and follow for more.
